title: Run roadmap tasks with isolated parallel model-backed agents
goal: Connect the existing susi tasks queue to the multi-model worker scheduler: select dependency-ready unclaimed tasks, atomically claim each with distinct worker identity and live lease, and assign each agent its own branch/worktree based on current origin/main. Different working models may implement different tasks simultaneously. Give workers AGENTS.md/self-build mandates and declared tool grants, acceptance command and task trailer requirements. Never share a worktree, steal an active claim, dispatch an open dependency, edit primary/main or install dev binaries into the release instance. Hermetic temporary repositories and fake agents must prove parallel execution, claim races and workspace isolation. Implement nonzero tests named parallel_roadmap_agents_* in the production owning crate.
